Stopped due to low space. Free up space or lower the minimum and turn “Record sessions” on again; it also resumes in the next session.
Stopped due to an error writing the file. Turn “Record sessions” on again or start a new session to record again.

Each file stores the events of one session (connections, gestures, gears and errors), without the raw frames. It may include network addresses and device names: review it before sharing. The 20 most recent sessions are kept.

What to connect to start riding
Connect your trainer, a controller and your indoor cycling app.
Gives the resistance and measures your power and cadence.
Receives your power and sends you the gradient.
The app simulates the gears and shows your data while you ride.
How you can use the app
Smart Bike simulates the gears. You ride in one of these modes:
No indoor cycling app. Flat terrain: your gear sets the effort.
With an app like Zwift, which sends the route\'s gradient. Your gears add to it.
Fixed power, whatever your cadence. In ERG MANUAL you set it; in ERG APP the app\'s workout does.
SIM and ERG APP need your app connected (next page); FREE and ERG MANUAL do not.
Connect %1$s to your indoor cycling app
Put the phone on the same Wi-Fi network as the device running the app (e.g. Zwift).
In the app, choose \"%1$s\" as power, cadence and trainer, over Wi-Fi.
If you use a controller, choose it in the controller list: it appears with the phone\'s Bluetooth name. Don\'t pair the Square in the app.
Turn on Bluetooth on the device running the app. No Wi-Fi needed.
In the app, choose the phone (%1$s, its Bluetooth name) as trainer, power and cadence.
With a controller, choose it too as controller: it goes inside the same device. Don\'t pair the Square in the app.
Put the phone on the same Wi-Fi network as the device running Zwift.
In Zwift, choose \"%1$s\": it is a single device with trainer, heart rate and controller.
Zwift will show its own gear, not yours.
